data.title: ML Hooks Configuration - Actually Fixed
data.summary:
Found that previous session's hook configuration was NOT saved. The ~/.claude/settings.json only had the git-check Stop hook. 

Applied the actual fix by writing complete ML hook configuration:
- SessionStart: ml-session-start-hook.sh (cwd:Opus-code-test)
- PostToolUse: ml-tool-capture-hook.sh (cwd:Opus-code-test)
- Stop: ml-session-capture-hook.sh (cwd:Opus-code-test)

Verified hooks work by manual execution. Next session should see SessionStart fire automatically and ML data collection begin working.
